evidence: Prop. 2.14.18: scīlicet īnsānō nēmō in amōre videt
terms.comment: Literally “no one sees in love”: the second half of a line of Propertius, “of course no one sees in mad love”.

sources: John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency.
Quotations marked “Lewis & Short” are given as Lewis & Short cites them, in the house spelling; they have not been checked against a modern edition.
Propertius 2.14.18, checked against the edition of the Carmina in the Internet Archive (bookserver.archive.org, carmina00prop) (12 November 2026).
